Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Mmm. Ni. (Grinding) (Looks at another stone) Mmm. Ni. (Throws it in Bunka's mouth and looks at another stone) Mmm. Ni.  (Throws it in Bunka's mouth) Ah? Ni. (Camera pans to Bunka, who grinds another stone. A squirrel rolls by balancing on a nut) Ehh? (Gerb shows a stone) Ah! (Camera pans to the stone) A wah!

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: May Isabelock, Gerb n de maka wah.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa. So—so they're just gonna be talking in "cave-talk"?

Name: Dan
Dialog: Yeah, and I think Doofenshmirtz is just gonna grunt.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Well, how are people gonna know what's going on?

Name: Dan
Dialog: Well, periodically we'll just cut to you and me explaining it just like this, in this sort of photo-animation.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Wh—Why don't we just film it? Live action?

Name: Dan
Dialog: Nah, it's not in the budget.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Ah, yeah. How are the kids gonna know who we are?

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Oh! That's nice. Okay. But where's Perry?

Name: Dan
Dialog: (Prepares to write on the drawing board) Ah!

Name: Monobrow
Dialog: May tee-my, Gunga lunga. Gunga lunga Doofengung, gunga lunga.

Name: Monobrow
Dialog: Gunga lunga ga-lunga! Gunga lunga bleah...

Name: Caveman
Dialog: Arga barga bit junga ba googa googa de wha?

Name: Mog
Dialog: Aba gaba, dar. Don du-pak du schtok.

Name: Mog
Dialog: Bakoo ar! (Mog unbends her back. She walks to a mirror and sees her hair) Chakka lakka! Can-tok? (Gets her staff) De garaba-oot.

Name: Mog
Dialog: Ya, Can-tok. Yar in char-ka. (Gives Can-tok the staff)

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Ah quag, Mog! (Looks at the staff) Can-tok in charga. (evil laughing)

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Phinabunk n Gerb! Can-tok in charka!

Name: Phinabuk
Dialog: Can-tok in charka? Du marka sada laka?

Name: Doofengung
Dialog: Ah, Bunka da Bunka Quwonk... baka-laka!

Name: Doofengung
Dialog: Ah,. Ah, Bunka da Bunka Quwonk...

Name: Doofengung
Dialog: Uh? Blahh! (A piece of a stalactite breaks off) Uh? Blahh! Uh? Blahh! Uh? BLAHH!!!

Name: Dan
Dialog: You know what? I think you're right. This was a bad idea.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: No, no, no, no... Th-This is starting to work. This is really good.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Yeah. Get, get up, get up, get out of the way! Give me the pen. So Phinabunk and Gerb have already invented the wheel and are getting ready to show their friends...

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Ah, ta-da! (He hums as he rolls with his wheel. He stops at Boofgard and gets off) Ta-da!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Oh! (Walks outside) Phinabunk n Gerb, goo bunga dun dun dun!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Phinabunk n Gerb, goonga bunga busta! De telok Mog! (Calls out) Mog!

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: (Points and commands each of the others, who are riding their own wheels) Da! Da! Da!

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Gerb, de gunga makea du kanga!

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Gerb? (Gerb displays a small tablet inscribed with what appears to be a Humvee design)

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Mog! Phinabunk n Gerb gunga bunga du wah! Du wah! Du wah! (Pause) DU WAH!

Name: Doofengung
Dialog: Ah, Bunka da Bunka Quwonk. Ah. (Laughs) Ah rar! (Opens the curtains) Da may deh henayar~! (Picks the Stick-Inator up) Ah? Eh? (Camera pans to Bunka) Ah! (Shows a stone drawing) Eh, Bunka da Bunka Quwonk. (Taps the stone drawing) Eh? Heh, eh? Heh?

Name: Dan
Dialog: Oh, so Doof's gonna poke the mammoths with his Stick-inator and they'll stampede Roger and his friends away from their home, and Doof can live there.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Well, then it's a good thing we're doing (Does a pose) this then.

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Can-tok ni in charka. Mog ni ghullunga Can-tok bok. (Notices a Humvee. The camera zooms out of a wheel, switches to Gerb, who's driving, Phinabunk, Baljug, Isabelock as passengers, and Boofgard is running on its back wheel. As they ride, the kids shout)

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Phinabunk n Gerb! (Runs after it. At a glacier he notices Jerabunk)

Name: Conk
Dialog: (Laughs) Phinabunk n Gerb! (The camera zooms out, noticing his foot stuck in the glacier) Ah, Bunka.

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: (Screams) (Lands on a tree, slides down it, breaking it's branches and slides down the volcano. As she stops, the rock on the staff is in the lava)

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Oh! Phinabunk n Gerb! Can-tok busta Phinabunk n Gerb! (Picks up the staff, noticing steam billowing from the rock) Kak shmolder laka? (Grabs the steam and lets go of it) Ah?

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: (Gasps) Mog! (Notices Mog, then the kids and the Humvee) Mog busta Phinabunk n Gerb! (Starts running) Mog! Mog!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Mog! Phinabunk n Gerb maka du kanga!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Mog, bota! (Notices that the Humvee is broken) Ni! (runs up to it) Ni, ni, ni, ni!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Ah, Can-tok makka foom-fa! (holds the staff high) Can-tok in charka!

Name: Doofengung
Dialog: Koya, Bunka da Bunka Quwonk! (Seeing Bunka walking away) Aw, bunka!

Name: Isabelock
Dialog: (wiggling her toes in front of the fire) Can-tok makka foom-fa!

Name: Gerb
Dialog: I guess we should wait until tomorrow before we tell them about our new language.

Name: Dan
Dialog: Eh, all right, I'll buy that, but it still feels like it's missing something.

Name: Baljug
Dialog: (Yaiiii, yai yai yai yai yai yai yai yai yaaiioh!)
